description: Literal substitutions applied, in this order, to every text file copied from the original run folders into runs/. $HOME is the home directory of the machine that ran the experiments and $USER its user name; tools/scrub_copy.py expands them at copy time, so the literal values never enter the repository. Model-written text is otherwise unchanged. Files that are not valid UTF-8 are copied byte for byte. Original run folders are never edited.
